$comment: Golden vectors for docs/STUDIO_ROOM_SCHEMA.md. Consumers: StudioRoomSchemaVectorTests (NodalMerge.Studio.Integration.Tests). Frozen: these encodings are engine-map values, not content-addressed bytes, so vectors pin JSON *shape* stability (deserialize -> re-serialize -> structurally identical), not byte identity -- see the doc's Vectors section for why that's the correct bar here.

vectors.comment: Ordinary studio-node entry: namespace 'studio', key '{kind}/{entityId}', envelope value wrapping the payload as-is (not double-encoded).

entityId containing '/' (base/{proposalId} -- a work unit's pre-attempt branch snapshot, per MergeProposal.cs's own comment). This is the case naive '{kind}/{entityId}' splitting gets wrong: the key must be parsed by matching the known StudioNodeKind prefix, not by any fixed slash position.

payload.goal: Fix the SqliteConnection pool race in Integration.Tests

vectors.comment: Workgroup-room repositories map entry (D1/D2): repoId key, repoRoomId = 'repo/{repoId}', two root SHAs (unrelated-history merge -> a set), one ssh remote normalized from scp-form.

remote_normalization_examples.comment: explicit ssh URI form, default port 22 dropped

vectors.comment: Pinned cross-repo reference (D3): (repoId, generationId, path). path is repo-relative, forward slashes, no leading slash -- same rule as tree-object entry paths.
